parse.title: Shadow Sorcerer (Incident)
parse.text:
Overview

Shadow Sorcerer (Incident) is a MythicalMythical unit. He is obtainable through summons, or by evolving Shadow Sorcerer (Hybrid Shadow).

Evolving

Shadow Sorcerer (Incident) can evolve into Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Shadow Sorcerer (Incident)
x200 Sacred Treasure
x1 Sacred Treasure (Adapted)
Result
Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 7500 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
